# JTG Master Plumbing

## About
JTG Master Plumbing offers gas pipe inspections under Local Law 152 without any conflicts of interest. Owner and NYC Licensed Master Plumber Francis R. Pfeiffer III conducts inspections with no affiliated repair contracts or financial incentive to fail a building. The business is based in the Bronx, NY, and is available 24/7.

## Services
Gas Pipe Inspection
Full Compliance Support

## Service Areas
Bronx
NYC and surrounding areas
